rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a series of events or successive states leading somewhere.

example.english: The process from designing to shipping this product went smoothly.
example.traditional: 呢個產品由設計到出貨嘅過程好順利。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 jau4 cit3 gai3 dou3 ceot1 fo3 ge3 gwo3 cing4 hou2 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Use 處理 as the all-purpose verb for handling data, signals, or other technical information.

example.english: This computer can process a large amount of data.
example.traditional: 部電腦可以處理大量資料。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 ho2 ji5 cyu2 lei5 daai6 loeng6 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use 消化 when someone needs time to take in and mentally come to terms with information or an idea.

example.english: This news is so sudden; I need some time to process it.
example.traditional: 呢個消息太突然，我要啲時間消化下。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 taai3 dat6 jin4 ngo5 jiu3 di1 si4 gaan3 siu1 faa3 haa5
